title: VOID PVP — Mod registry
description: The closed registry of the 12 mods defined in PVP_ARCHITECTURE.md §3, together with the per-mod settings sub-schema, the anti-cheat classification of §11, the Mods-panel `category` taxonomy of Figma 244:538 and the factory defaults. This file is the single source of truth for mod identity, display copy and classification: `loadout.json` and `bridge.json` both $ref its `mod_id` enum and its `<id>_settings` definitions, so a mod is added in exactly one place, and no consumer re-declares a label or a filter tab. An instance of this schema is a registry document; the registry VOID actually ships is `examples[0]`.

version.title: Registry version
version.description: Integer revision of the registry document. Bumped whenever a mod is added, removed or reclassified. Independent of the wire protocol version `v` in protocol.json.

mods.title: Mods
mods.description: Every mod VOID ships, keyed by its snake_case mod id. Closed set: all 12 keys are required and no others are permitted.

mod_id.title: Mod id
mod_id.description: Closed enum of the 12 mods of §3, snake_case. Used as the key of `loadout.mods`, as the `id` argument of `void.setModSetting`, and as the id of a HUD item.

hud_mod_id.title: HUD mod id
hud_mod_id.description: The subset of mod ids whose `kind` is `hud`, i.e. the mods that own a draggable HUD item. A mod may only appear in `loadout.hud` if it is listed here.

gameplay_mod_id.title: Gameplay mod id
gameplay_mod_id.description: The subset of mod ids whose `kind` is `gameplay`, i.e. the mods an actuator Mixin reads every frame. These are the only ids accepted by `void.setGameplay`.

kind.title: Mod kind
kind.description: Data direction of the mod, per §3. `hud` mods only read game state and draw; `gameplay` mods mutate a documented client-side option through an actuator Mixin.

category.title: Mod category
category.description: The product taxonomy the Mods panel filters across — the tabs `All / HUD / PvP / Visual / Utility` of Figma 244:538, and the tag printed on each tile. Distinct from `kind`, which is a data-direction split (does the mod draw, or does it mutate a client-side option): Crosshair is `kind: gameplay` but `category: visual`, and Zoom is `kind: gameplay` but `category: utility`. Carried here so no consumer has to hard-code the mapping.

key_swatch.title: Key colour swatch
key_swatch.description: One of the five unpressed-key swatches on the Mod settings frame, named by the design token it resolves to (`--bg-shell`, `--surface-2`, `--surface-3`, `--sky`, `--teal`). A name rather than a hex value so the choice survives a theme change.

pressed_swatch.title: Pressed colour swatch
pressed_swatch.description: One of the five pressed-key swatches on the Mod settings frame, named by the design token it resolves to (`--accent`, `--sky`, `--warn`, `--danger`, `--teal`). `accent` is the frame's default and follows the loadout accent.

hypixel_safe.title: Hypixel safety class
hypixel_safe.description: Anti-cheat posture of §11. `safe` mods are unambiguously allowed; `grey` mods change what the player can see and are tolerated but not endorsed. The HYPIXEL-READY badge is shown only when every enabled mod in the loadout is `safe`.

keybind.title: Keybind
keybind.description: An LWJGL 2 key name in upper case as used by Minecraft 1.8.9 `Keyboard.getKeyName`, a mouse button as MOUSE0..MOUSE7, or NONE for unbound. Produced by `void.openKeybindCapture`.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: Multiplier applied to the mod's rendered size, on top of MC GUI scale x window DPI (§6.2). 1 is the design size.

opacity.title: Opacity
opacity.description: Alpha of the mod's rendered element, 0 fully transparent to 1 fully opaque.

hex_color.title: Colour
hex_color.description: sRGB colour as #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA. Lower case or upper case hex both accepted.

on.title: Enabled
on.description: Whether the mod is enabled. Present in every mod state inside a loadout, and in the registry `defaults` as the factory enabled state.

mod_entry.title: Registry entry
mod_entry.description: One row of the §3 table plus its §11 classification and factory defaults. Every key is listed here; the per-mod entry definitions narrow `id`, `kind`, `hypixel_safe` and `defaults` to constants.

id.description: The mod's snake_case id; equals the key this entry is stored under.

kind.description: Whether this mod draws (hud) or mutates a client-side option (gameplay).

category.description: Filter-tab taxonomy of the Mods panel, per frame 244:538.

label.description: Human-readable name as it appears in the Mods panel of the Figma.

description.description: One-line explanation shown under the label in the Mods panel.

source.description: The Minecraft 1.8.9 field, method or injection point the sensor reads or the actuator writes, quoted from the §3 table. Documentation only; not consumed at runtime.

defaults.description: Factory settings for this mod, used when a loadout omits it. Validates against the mod's own settings sub-schema.

fps_settings.title: FPS display settings
fps_settings.description: Settings for the FPS display HUD mod. Reads `Minecraft.debugFPS` once per tick.

on.description: Whether the FPS display is enabled.

scale.description: Size multiplier of the FPS tile.

color.description: Text colour of the FPS readout.

show_label.description: Whether to render the trailing "FPS" label after the number.

keystrokes_settings.title: Keystrokes settings
keystrokes_settings.description: Settings for the Keystrokes HUD mod. Fed by the edge-triggered `keys` bridge event (§6.5), never by polling.

on.description: Whether the keystrokes overlay is enabled.

scale.description: Size multiplier of the key tiles.

opacity.description: Alpha of the key tiles when a key is not pressed.

keybind.description: Optional key that toggles the keystrokes overlay on and off in game without opening the menu. NONE leaves it always visible while the mod is on.

show_mouse.description: Whether to render the LMB and RMB tiles under the WASD block.

show_spacebar.description: Whether to render the spacebar tile.

show_cps.description: Whether to print the current CPS inside the LMB and RMB tiles.

corner_radius.description: Corner radius of a key tile in unscaled GUI pixels, drawn as the `Corner radius` slider on the Mod settings frame (Figma 244:834). 0 is a square tile.

key_color.description: Background of an unpressed key tile, as one of the five named swatches the Mod settings frame offers. A token name rather than a hex value, so the tile keeps following the theme when the theme changes.

pressed_color.description: Fill of a pressed key tile, as one of the five named swatches the Mod settings frame offers. `accent` follows the loadout accent, which is the frame's default.

cps_settings.title: CPS counter settings
cps_settings.description: Settings for the CPS counter HUD mod. Derived entirely in JS from mouse edges on the `keys` event (§3), so no Java sensor exists for it.

on.description: Whether the CPS counter is enabled.

scale.description: Size multiplier of the CPS tile.

mode.description: Which mouse buttons to count: left only, right only, or both shown side by side.

window_ms.description: Length of the sliding window in milliseconds over which clicks are counted before being scaled to clicks per second.

ping_settings.title: Ping display settings
ping_settings.description: Settings for the Ping display HUD mod. Reads the player's own `NetworkPlayerInfo.responseTime`.

on.description: Whether the ping display is enabled.

scale.description: Size multiplier of the ping tile.

show_label.description: Whether to render the trailing "ms" unit after the number.

good_ms.description: Ping at or below this many milliseconds renders in the good colour.

bad_ms.description: Ping at or above this many milliseconds renders in the bad colour. Must be greater than `good_ms`; not enforced by the schema.

coordinates_settings.title: Coordinates settings
coordinates_settings.description: Settings for the Coordinates HUD mod. Reads `EntityPlayerSP` position and yaw once per tick.

on.description: Whether the coordinates display is enabled.

scale.description: Size multiplier of the coordinates tile.

decimals.description: Number of decimal places printed for X, Y and Z.

show_direction.description: Whether to append the cardinal direction derived from yaw.

layout.description: Whether X, Y and Z are stacked on three lines or printed on one.

armor_status_settings.title: Armor status settings
armor_status_settings.description: Settings for the Armor status HUD mod. Reads `InventoryPlayer.armorInventory` durability, pushed only when it changes.

on.description: Whether the armor status display is enabled.

scale.description: Size multiplier of the armor row.

orientation.description: Whether armor pieces are laid out left to right or top to bottom.

show_durability.description: Whether to print remaining durability as a number under each piece.

show_held_item.description: Whether to include the currently held item as a sixth slot.

potion_effects_settings.title: Potion effects settings
potion_effects_settings.description: Settings for the Potion effects HUD mod. Reads `getActivePotionEffects`, pushed only when the set changes.

on.description: Whether the potion effects display is enabled.

scale.description: Size multiplier of the effect list.

show_duration.description: Whether to print the remaining duration next to each effect.

show_amplifier.description: Whether to print the roman-numeral amplifier next to each effect name.

hide_ambient.description: Whether to omit ambient effects such as a beacon aura from the list.

toggle_sprint_settings.title: Toggle sprint settings
toggle_sprint_settings.description: Settings for the Toggle sprint gameplay mod. Overrides the sprint `KeyBinding` in `onLivingUpdate`.

mode.description: `toggle` latches sprint until the key is pressed again; `hold` restores vanilla hold-to-sprint but keeps the status readout.

sneak_too.description: Whether the same latching behaviour is applied to sneak.

show_status.description: Whether the mod draws its own [Sprinting] status line above the hotbar.

fullbright_settings.title: Fullbright settings
fullbright_settings.description: Settings for the Fullbright gameplay mod. Overrides `gameSettings.gammaSetting`; client-side only and Watchdog-tolerated (§3), but classified `grey` in §11.

gamma.description: Value written to `gammaSetting` while the mod is on. Vanilla's slider tops out at 1; 10 is the conventional fullbright value.

hitboxes_settings.title: Hitboxes settings
hitboxes_settings.description: Settings for the Hitboxes gameplay mod. Forces `RenderManager.debugBoundingBox`. Classified `grey` in §11.

line_width.description: GL line width used for the bounding box wireframe.

color.description: Colour of the bounding box wireframe.

show_eye_line.description: Whether to draw the vanilla eye-direction ray along with the box.

zoom_settings.title: Zoom settings
zoom_settings.description: Settings for the Zoom gameplay mod. Overrides FOV while `key` is held.

key.description: Key held to zoom. Captured through `void.openKeybindCapture('zoom')`.

fov_divisor.description: The player's FOV is divided by this factor while zoomed. 4 approximates the familiar Optifine zoom.

smooth.description: Whether the FOV change is eased over a few frames rather than snapping.

cinematic.description: Whether smooth-camera mouse damping is applied while zoomed.

crosshair_settings.title: Crosshair settings
crosshair_settings.description: Settings for the Crosshair mod. Uniquely among the 12 it is drawn in GL rather than HTML (§3 footnote) because it must sit at the exact pixel centre, but it is configured through the same loadout model as everything else.

on.description: Whether the vanilla crosshair pass is replaced.

style.description: Shape drawn at the screen centre.

size.description: Half-length in pixels of each crosshair arm, before GUI scale.

thickness.description: Stroke thickness in pixels, before GUI scale.

gap.description: Empty gap in pixels between the centre point and the start of each arm.

outline.description: Whether a one-pixel black outline is drawn around the shape for contrast.

dynamic.description: Whether the gap widens while the attack cooldown is not full and while sprinting.

fps_entry.title: FPS display entry
fps_entry.description: Registry entry for the FPS display, narrowed to its constant classification.

category.description: Always `hud`; the Mods panel tabs it under HUD (frame 244:538).

keystrokes_entry.title: Keystrokes entry
keystrokes_entry.description: Registry entry for Keystrokes, narrowed to its constant classification.

category.description: Always `hud`; the Mods panel tabs it under HUD (frame 244:538).

cps_entry.description: Registry entry for the CPS counter, narrowed to its constant classification.

category.description: Always `hud`; the Mods panel tabs it under HUD (frame 244:538).

ping_entry.description: Registry entry for the Ping display, narrowed to its constant classification.

category.description: Always `hud`; the Mods panel tabs it under HUD (frame 244:538).

hypixel_safe.description: Always `safe`; §11 does not list ping explicitly, and a read of the player's own responseTime cannot affect play.

coordinates_entry.title: Coordinates entry
coordinates_entry.description: Registry entry for Coordinates, narrowed to its constant classification.

category.description: Always `hud`; the Mods panel tabs it under HUD (frame 244:538).

armor_status_entry.description: Registry entry for Armor status, narrowed to its constant classification.

category.description: Always `hud`; the Mods panel tabs it under HUD (frame 244:538).

potion_effects_entry.title: Potion effects entry
potion_effects_entry.description: Registry entry for Potion effects, narrowed to its constant classification.

category.description: Always `hud`; the Mods panel tabs it under HUD (frame 244:538).

toggle_sprint_entry.title: Toggle sprint entry
toggle_sprint_entry.description: Registry entry for Toggle sprint, narrowed to its constant classification.

category.description: Always `pvp`; the Mods panel tabs it under PvP (frame 244:538).

fullbright_entry.title: Fullbright entry
fullbright_entry.description: Registry entry for Fullbright, narrowed to its constant classification.

category.description: Always `visual`; the Mods panel tabs it under Visual (frame 244:538).

hitboxes_entry.title: Hitboxes entry
hitboxes_entry.description: Registry entry for Hitboxes, narrowed to its constant classification.

category.description: Always `pvp`; the Mods panel tabs it under PvP (frame 244:538).

zoom_entry.title: Zoom entry
zoom_entry.description: Registry entry for Zoom, narrowed to its constant classification.

category.description: Always `utility`; the Mods panel tabs it under Utility (frame 244:538).

crosshair_entry.title: Crosshair entry
crosshair_entry.description: Registry entry for Crosshair, narrowed to its constant classification.

kind.description: Always `gameplay`; §3 marks it Gameplay* because it is drawn in GL rather than HTML, but its data direction is that of an actuator.

category.description: Always `visual`; the Mods panel tabs it under Visual (frame 244:538).

hypixel_safe.description: Always `safe`; §11 does not list crosshair explicitly, and it is a purely cosmetic replacement of the vanilla crosshair pass.

fps.label: FPS display
fps.description: Frames per second, updated once per tick.

keystrokes.label: Keystrokes
keystrokes.description: WASD, mouse and spacebar tiles that light up as you press them.

cps.label: CPS counter
cps.description: Clicks per second over a sliding window.

ping.label: Ping display
ping.description: Round-trip time to the current server.

armor_status.label: Armor status
armor_status.description: Worn armor and held item with remaining durability.

potion_effects.label: Potion effects
potion_effects.description: Active potion effects with amplifier and remaining duration.

toggle_sprint.label: Toggle sprint
toggle_sprint.description: Latches sprint instead of holding the key.

fullbright.label: Fullbright
fullbright.description: Raises gamma so caves and shadows are fully lit.

zoom.label: Zoom
zoom.description: Narrows FOV while the zoom key is held.

crosshair.label: Crosshair
crosshair.description: Replaces the vanilla crosshair with a configurable one at the exact screen centre.
